status: Frozen before inspection of forward-model fitted observable differences or scores; generated/written totals and nominal P21 quality count already known.
estimand: Retrospective selected-sample observational distribution checks of public-assets P21, BS21, G10 and six P21 perturbations. Not a physical population posterior, Bayes factor, cosmology comparison, or independent validation of historical DES-tuned parameters.
primary_sample: Original DES Hubble-diagram members, published SNNV19>0.999, coherent conditioned-multistart-best fits, additionally applying identical basic fitted cuts to observations and simulations. Frozen original-CID folds1-4 train, fold0 test.
basic_cuts: abs(x1)<3; abs(c)<0.3; x1ERR<1; PKMJDERR<2; cERR<1.5; FITPROB>0.001; 0.025<zHD<1.2; coherent positive Hessian. Use actual noisy fitted quantities, not intrinsic SIM_SALT2c or predust SIM_SALT2mB.
conditioning: Exact observed field label, measured host-mass bin below/above10, Gaussian redshift kernel bandwidth0.10, zero beyond3 bandwidths. No fitted observable or error is used to construct weights. Compound-field real labels absent in simulations are unsupported, not silently relabelled.
support: For each observation and each of nine arms require at least10 nonzero simulated weights and Kish effective count>=8. Common-support intersection across all arms, evaluated from conditioning variables only. No outcome-based bandwidth/cell choice. Report all excluded original test CIDs and reasons.
magnitude_alignment: Simulation observable is measured mB minus its generated distance modulus. Real observable is measured mB minus flat constant-q=0 reference distance. For each model separately, fit unpenalized linear-interpolation magnitude offsets on fixed z knots[0.025,0.20,0.35,0.50,0.65,0.80,1.20], using train objects only and the model's conditional simulated mean. Evaluate interpolated offsets unchanged on heldout objects. Offset fit is ordinary least squares; no LCDM ranking. Check basis rank, report weak high-z support.
scores: Weighted empirical energy score for joint(c/0.1,x1) primary and joint(magnitude/0.3,c/0.1,x1) secondary; lower better. The weighted empirical distribution defines the forecast; the energy pair term uses its exact finite-distribution V statistic, including zero-distance diagonal. Marginal CRPS in physical units for c,x1,mB. Report scores paired on identical heldout objects against P21; finite pilot Monte Carlo uncertainty retained. No KDE density or evidential physical winner.
diagnostics: Mean observed-minus-predicted c,x1; colour>0.1 fraction; squared x1 and colour moments; 68/95 percent marginal predictive interval coverage and PIT means; fitted-error and FITPROB distribution contrasts. All predictions integrate simulated observed noise by using actual refits; no second measurement-error convolution.
uncertainty: 300 reproducible bootstrap replicates: independent object multinomial resampling of realtrain and realtest; shared generated-attempt Poisson weights across9 simulation arms; refit all training magnitude offsets each replicate. Percentile95 intervals for each reported contrast, conditional on fixed support and nuisance design. Paired field-cluster t sensitivity from the10 field means. Repeated independent simulation realizations and calibration/systematic uncertainty are unavailable.
